headline: Monte Carlo Fashions Limited: Regulation 31(4) Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Monte Carlo Fashions Limited filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares triggering takeover code obligations. The filing documents acquisition of shares meeting or exceeding the 25% threshold under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Monte Carlo Fashions Limited, a listed apparel and fashion brand on NSE, submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the exchange. This regulation governs disclosure of substantial acquisitions of shares and interests in shares. The filing indicates that the acquirer has crossed a disclosure threshold (typically 25% or acquisition leading to change of control). Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of acquisition and intended onward dealings; concurrent review of Regulations 3(4) and 33 (open offer) obligations is mandatory.
